description: Read one monitor's full configuration and current state. It has type, target, interval_seconds, timeout_seconds, regions, config, status, is_active, confirmation_threshold, notification_cooldown_seconds, channel_ids (empty means every verified, active channel is alerted), tags, badge_enabled, last_checked_at, next_run_at, and for SSL monitors ssl_expires_at and ssl_cert_info. Use it before update_monitor, since a config you send replaces the stored one whole. Not for finding a monitor (list_monitors), its uptime (get_uptime_summary) or why it fails (list_check_results).

monitor_id.description: The monitor's uuid from list_monitors. An id that is not a monitor of this organization, or a deleted one, is a 404.

name: get_monitor

region_statuses.description:
Per-region latest status, sorted by region name.

Built from ``region_snapshots``; ``job_id`` is dropped (internal
dedup key) and malformed/partial snapshot rows are skipped rather
than failing the read.

status.description: Known values: UP, DEGRADED, DOWN, ERROR.
Known values: PENDING, UP, DEGRADED, DOWN, PAUSED.

type.description: Known values: HTTP, PING, SSL, TCP, DNS.
